name: SeasonsRewardsU16List
summary: One u16 member body of the SeasonsRewardsTrackedStat replicated state: a prefix-varint delta count (pinned to 0), the strict zero-or-one delta, then a prefix-varint element count and that many big-endian u16. The client's own container reader 0x142f9b430 is the sibling non-zero branch; every recorded body takes the zero-count branch.
purpose: Name the u16 member layout that the two-level presence mask selects (group 0 members 2 and 3 of codec.seasons-rewards-tracked-stat-replicated-state), so the mask card references a record instead of copying the container's layout.

fields.name: deltaCount
fields.note: The prefix-varint delta count 0x142f9b430 reads before it branches. It is 0 in both measured bodies, which select the +0x78 branch 0x142f9d1d0; the non-zero masked-map branch has no instance, so the card bounds this field to 0 and refuses anything else.

fields.name: delta
fields.note: The zero-count branch 0x142f9d1d0: a strict zero-or-one presence byte through FUN_1461adf60, then one prefix varint when it is 1. Both measured bodies carry 01 08 (8).

fields.name: elements
fields.note: A second prefix-varint element count and that many big-endian u16, read by FUN_14087a360. groupCountList carries 2 elements (30, 21), groupStatIndex 51. Meaning not established.

evidence.ref: Member reader 0x142f9b430 and its zero branch 0x142f9d1d0 (build 30fe6461).
